scripts.format: prettier --write index.html assets/web/css assets/web/js scripts tests package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.html assets/web/css assets/web/js scripts tests package.json
scripts.test:syntax: for file in assets/web/js/*.js scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$file"; done && ${PYTHON:-python3} -m py_compile tests/test_site_regression.py
